oracle.upgrade_policy: Changing the oracle requires a new contract identity and remeasurement, never silently reinterpreting old receipts.

dimensions.includes: Stable Rust syntax, static semantics, observable runtime semantics and Edition 2024 behavior for the pinned oracle.
Stable public core, alloc and std API surface and observable behavior available on the target, including unsafe preconditions.
Existing manifests, dependencies, crate types, cfg/features, build scripts, procedural macros and native linking.
CHECK, BUILD and observable execution, invalid unused items, diagnostics classification, failure isolation and graph correctness.
Version-pinned unchanged real projects, with explicit corpus selection biases and environment prerequisites.

evidence_policy.positive: Pinned stock acceptance plus native CHECK/BUILD and observable run comparison at workers 1 and 8, with no stock compiler fallback.
evidence_policy.negative: Pinned stock rejection plus native semantic rejection of the same source, including unused invalid items. Parser refusal, unsupported, resource exhaustion, infrastructure failure, crash and timeout do not establish semantic rejection.
evidence_policy.undefined_behavior: Do not require matching runtime output for programs with undefined behavior. Track safe and unsafe preconditions, compiler-enforced restrictions and documented guarantees separately.
evidence_policy.unspecified_behavior: Compare documented allowed outcomes rather than requiring one accidental stock outcome when behavior is unspecified or implementation-dependent.
evidence_policy.provenance: Measurements require exact source, scope, oracle, runner and environment identities, complete shard coverage and immutable log-bound receipts.
evidence_policy.graph: Compiler acceptance also requires the existing graph-integrity gates. Stock parity alone is insufficient.
evidence_policy.pending: A missing or unmeasured obligation remains visible. An ignored test only provides evidence when explicitly executed.

exclusions.reason: Nightly-only features are a separate future contract, not silently enabled in stable fixtures.
Other architectures, operating systems and cross-compilation require separately enumerated target contracts.
Internal rustc architecture, artifact formats and exact diagnostic wording are not compatibility requirements unless externally promised.
Compiler performance is measured independently and is not inferred from semantic test pass rates.

readiness.rule: Do not publish a full-Rust percentage from a partial inventory. Report versioned obligation coverage, measured outcomes, missing tests, interaction coverage and ecosystem results separately. A finite test suite cannot prove equivalence for every possible program.

source_provenance_policy: Inventory references must identify official primary sources and their version limitations. Moving documentation is discovery evidence, not a frozen specification snapshot of the pinned oracle.
